articles.title: BlackRock's new bitcoin income fund offers cash flow alongside BTC exposure
articles.snippet: After IBIT's $49 billion success, BlackRock says clients are increasingly seeking ways to earn income from long-term bitcoin holdings.

articles.title: ‘Crypto spring’ is here, says one analyst after bitcoin's key signals turn bullish
articles.snippet: Standard Chartered analyst Geoffrey Kendrick's bullish call comes as spot bitcoin exchange-traded fund inflows return, oil prices fall and Coinbase's CEO says bitcoin likely bottomed near $60,000.

articles.title: Crypto PAC has $12M stake in Senate primary runoff as Alabama voters head to polls
articles.snippet: Defend American Jobs reported spending $7.4 million on media to support Republican Barry Moore ahead of his May 20 Alabama primary, and an additional $4.7 million before Tuesday’s runoffs.

articles.title: Bitcoin sell-off toward $60K may resume as Japan hikes interest rates
articles.snippet: Japan’s highest rates since 1995 are putting global liquidity back in focus as traders anticipate 26%–38% BTC price declines.

articles.title: Robinhood cuts 10% of workforce as Tenev touts business strength
articles.snippet: Robinhood cuts about 10% of staff as CEO Vlad Tenev says business “has never been stronger” despite weak Q1 trading.
